description: Logs voltages to a CSV file. Each pulse at the trigger input writes the voltages standing at the twenty value inputs as one row of the file

inputs.text: A pulse writes the voltages at the twenty value inputs as one row of the file
One of the twenty voltages written into each row of the file

notes: no file is chosen when the module is placed; the first save opens a dialog for choosing where the CSV is written
the columns written stop at the last value input that has a cable in it, so inputs beyond that are left out of the file
menu: CHOOSE destination file... — picks the CSV file the log is written to, shown in the panel menu as ARMED FILE
AUTO ENUMERATE SAVES — numbers each new save, so a fresh file is written without asking for a name
LOGGING SEPARATOR — sets the character written between the values in a row: comma, full stop, semicolon, vertical bar, TAB, ampersand, exclamation mark or question mark
